subject: Dedicated KMS Mode — rotation window exception & audit delivery plan
messages:
From: Diana Singh <d.singh@solacehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@solacehealth.com, security@solacehealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask — Dedicated KMS mode: rotation window exception and audit delivery

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team has a couple of follow-ups before we sign the pilot SOW: primarily around Dedicated KMS mode. Two asks: 1) we need an approved rotation window exemption for short-lived keys used only during batch inference (we cannot rotate during our booking window: 02:00–06:00 PT), and 2) we require daily delivery of cryptographically signed audit exports to our S3 bucket (encrypted with our CMK).

Can you confirm if Redwood can:
- Provide a documented exception process for rotation windows (including approval owners and SLAs)
- Push daily audit exports (parquet) to an external S3 and include an HMAC signature file
- Provide the timeline for engineering/product to enable these for the pilot

We'd like to get this in place before the pilot start (target: 2028-06-10). Attaching a short checklist on what Solace needs for procurement.

Thanks,
Diana Singh
Head of InfoSec, Solace Health

Subject: Re: Pilot ask — Dedicated KMS mode: rotation window exception and audit delivery

Team — forwarding Solace's two asks. High level: both are feasible but require coordination across Dedicated runtime, KMS integration, and the audit-export pipeline.

Specific unknowns I want to surface:
- Rotation exception: is this something we can operationalize now as an "approved rotation window" per-tenant flag (with manual audit trail), or do we need a short-lived policy change in the KMS plugin that defers rotation?
- Audit exports: we already have internal daily audit dumps, but pushing signed/exported files to a customer-managed S3 with an HMAC signed file (customer key) is not something we've automated for Dedicated customers yet.

Marissa — can you map product/infra work: estimated T-shirt sizing and dependencies?
Grace — ops: what's the minimal audit content Solace needs to consider it 'signed' (we use per-file signatures today; do we need envelope signing?)
Kim — legal/procurement ask: any contract caveats for pushing exports to external buckets?

I'll coordinate with Solace on target dates once we have internal alignment.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: d.singh@solacehealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 15:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — Dedicated KMS mode: rotation window exception and audit delivery

Quick product breakdown and proposed plan (high level):

1) Rotation window exception
- Proposal: implement a per-tenant 'rotation window' config which sets a no-rotation interval. This is enforced by the KMS orchestration layer and recorded in an "exception record" (who approved, start/end dates, justification).
- Effort: 2 sprints (infra + one backend engineer) to add flag + audit record + UI hook in Console.
- Risk: this increases manual exception surface; need a 1-click revoke and daily audit entry.
- Deliverable: rotation_window-proposal.xlsx attached with flows.

2) Audit delivery to external S3
- Proposal: reuse audit-export pipeline; add per-tenant destination config and an optional envelope HMAC (computed by Redwood using a shared secret supplied by Solace). File format: parquet + .sig (HMAC SHA256).
- Effort: 3 sprints (backend + infra) to add secure credentials handling (customer-supplied temporary key via our transfer agent), delivery retries, and signed manifest.
- Risk: credential handling and cross-account data movement (we'll use IAM role assumption where possible).

Timeline suggestion: parallel work, kickoff next week (2028-05-28), MVP by 2028-06-14 for pilot start on 2028-06-21. If Solace needs earlier, we can request a scoped exception (manual export) while automation lands.

Attachments: rotation_window-proposal.xlsx, audit-delivery-flow.drawio

Action owners:
- Marissa (product) -> specification + acceptance criteria
- Grace (ops) -> audit schema + ops runbook
- Jonas (reliability) -> pilot rollout plan + SLO fallback
- Kimberly (legal/procurement) -> contract language for external S3 delivery

I will prepare a short RFC and acceptance checklist by EoW Friday.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior PM, Platform — Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: d.singh@solacehealth.com
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — Dedicated KMS mode: rotation window exception and audit delivery

Thanks Marissa — a few ops clarifications from my side:

- Audit content: Solace asked for cryptographically signed audit exports. For parity with our current internal format, we'll push a compressed parquet file + a detached signature file (ED25519 or HMAC option). Recommendation: default to ED25519 signed by Redwood's audit key and also provide an HMAC option if Solace wants to compute/verify with their shared secret.
- Delivery guarantees: we'll provide daily exports with up to 48-hour retry window for downstream transient failures. We will include manifest metadata (UTC timestamp, sequence id, sha256).
- Rotation exception mechanics: implement the per-tenant exception record (read-only after approval) stored in our audit DB. Approvals should be recorded (approver email + timestamp) and surfaceable in Console and runbooks. Operationally, rotation will be skipped only for keys tagged as 'pilot-ephemeral' for the tenant.

Operational ask for infra: we'll need IAM role mapping and a short playbook for re-keying if Solace revokes access. Also need product to confirm whether Solace wants Redwood to compute HMAC using a customer-supplied secret or they will validate ED25519 only.

I'll draft the runbook and the manifest spec; aim to share Wednesday AM.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Platform Ops — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot ask — Dedicated KMS mode: rotation window exception and audit delivery

Diana — thanks for the clear asks and for the patience while we scoped. Short answer: yes, we can support both items for the pilot with the plan below.

Committed plan (summary):
- Rotation window exception: will ship as a per-tenant 'rotation_window' exception record (Console UI + API) that prevents scheduled rotations for keys tagged 'pilot-ephemeral' during 02:00–06:00 PT. Approval capture and immutable audit trail included. Target: manual approval flow ready by 2028-06-07.
- Audit delivery: daily parquet exports + detached signature (.sig) delivered to Solace S3 via role-assume. By default signed with ED25519 from Redwood's audit key; optional HMAC mode can be enabled if Solace provides a shared secret. Target: automated delivery and manifest by 2028-06-14.

Work to start next week. If you need the exports earlier, we can schedule a one-off manual export while automation completes.

Next steps for Solace please:
1) Confirm preferred signature mode (ED25519 preferred or HMAC with shared secret).
2) Provide S3 bucket ARN and preferred IAM trust policy for our transfer agent.
3) Sign the SOW addendum (DocuSign link below) so we can onboard infra access.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/solace/agreements/REQ-4982
Drive spec: https://drive.redwoodinternal.com/teams/eng/solace-pilot/rotation-proposal

Thanks — I'll hold a 30-min kickoff with your security/ops once we get the answers above.
